episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kang Da Wit's rise as a judge comes to a crashing halt after a scandal. But a far less glamorous opportunity offers him an unexpected new start.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Initially reluctant to lead a scrappy team, Da Wit takes on a case involving a stolen stray dog — but his unconventional tactics leave everyone stunned.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: While they often clash, Da Wit and the pro bono team begin to find their rhythm. Soon, a young boy arrives as the next client with an impossible request.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As the case of the boy with a disability unfolds, Da Wit puts the court to the test — while the question of the boy's very worth comes under scrutiny.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Kaya, a foreign bride facing domestic abuse, seeks the team's help in her divorce. But her credibility comes into question amid brutal questioning.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As Kaya's past comes to light, the pro bono team faces an unexpected turn — pushing Da-wit and his colleagues to fight for her right to stay in Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: When the pro bono team learns they're being disbanded, Da-wit wagers that they can be valuable. Soon, they handle a case involving a popular singer.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: A shocking discovery complicates Eliyah's case, prompting the pro bono team to challenge her contract — even as public opinion turns against her.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: After the pro bono team narrowly avoids being shut down, a shadowy figure approaches Park Gi-ppeum — asking her to file a lawsuit against Da-wit.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Da-wit stands trial as a defendant, facing the very team he has mentored. Meanwhile, both sides hunt for the truth that could bring light to the turmoil.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Da-wit's fate lies in the hands of the pro bono team, whose allegiance begins to waver. But just as peace seems within reach, he faces a new lawsuit.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Da-wit finally brings Oh Gyu-jang — the mastermind behind the corruption of justice — before the court. Will he succeed in bringing the truth to light?
